# nemau network floating-ip

Manage floating IPs.

## Usage

```
nemau network floating-ip [command]
```

Alias: `fip`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [allocate](nemau_network_floating-ip_allocate.md) | Allocate a floating IP |
| [associate](nemau_network_floating-ip_associate.md) | Associate a floating IP with a target |
| [disassociate](nemau_network_floating-ip_disassociate.md) | Detach a floating IP from its target |
| [list](nemau_network_floating-ip_list.md) | List the floating IPs |
| [release](nemau_network_floating-ip_release.md) | Release a floating IP |
| [update](nemau_network_floating-ip_update.md) | Change a floating IP's description |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
